chapter: La Rocca on who created jazz
title: La Rocca asks Rust to confirm every New Orleans band had its chance
summary: La Rocca asks whether Rust has checked his claim that all bands failed; Rust says he believes him.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Tape changes, reel headers and session breaks

blocks.x: Can I ask you a question, Mr. Rust? Certainly. You remember me writing you and telling you that every colored and white band from New Orleans had their chance? Oh, yes.
Yes. In the beginning, I don't think you believe me, but you've checked this now, haven't you?
I have, yes. Yes, I believe you.

So you found every word that I have told you is the truth? Absolutely. Now they're going around today taking tape recordings of men who never went out as far as Calton Avenue. That's just not even the city line.
